endpoints: Two lines: Joshua Falls (Campbell County, VA) to Yeat (Culpeper County, VA), and Amos (Putnam County, WV) to Welton Spring (Hardy County, WV) to Rocky Point (Frederick County, MD)

geo.counties_basis: Joshua Falls-Yeat: up to 9 Virginia counties per Valley Link / news (preliminary routes). Valley North: counties with Valley Link open houses or named in its June 2026 announcement (study segments, no route chosen).

endpoints.basis: HIFLD substation layer point named JOSHUA FALLS (765 kV, Campbell Co.) for the existing station; Appalachian Power plans to relocate it about 2 miles southeast, and the new site is not geocoded.
endpoints.name: Joshua Falls Substation (Appalachian Power; to be relocated ~2 mi SE)

endpoints.basis: Culpeper County resolution places it in the Richardsville area of SE Culpeper County; point is the Richardsville hamlet (Nominatim).
endpoints.name: Yeat Substation (proposed, Dominion/Valley Link)

endpoints.basis: HIFLD substation layer point named JOHN AMOS (765 kV, Putnam Co.).
endpoints.name: Amos Substation (John E. Amos plant, AEP)

endpoints.basis: PJM: 'northwestern Hardy County'; opposition group says the purchased site is on US 220 south of Reynolds Gap Rd. Placed on the US 220 corridor south of Moorefield toward the Grant County line; the exact site is unknown, so allow ~5 mi of error.
endpoints.name: Welton Spring(s) Substation (proposed)

endpoints.basis: Described as about 2 mi south of the Doubs substation (HIFLD 39.2964,-77.5148) on Potomac Edison land behind the Rocky Point Creamery (OSM 39.2744,-77.5155), near Point of Rocks.
endpoints.name: Rocky Point Substation (proposed)

k2_action: Watch the West Virginia segment only; skip Northern Virginia.
name: Valley Link
next_step: State route approvals in Virginia and neighboring states.
status: Billion-dollar 765 kV line in the PJM region. Valley Link holds 12 drop-in open houses in November 2026 showing potential routes for the first time. West Virginia dates: Nov 4 Fisher and Hambleton (Tucker County HS), Nov 5 Charleston (Sissonville MS), Nov 12 Buckhannon (Brushy Fork), Nov 17 Spencer and Capon Bridge, plus others; Virginia and Maryland: Nov 5 Winchester, Nov 12 Lovettsville, Nov 19 Brunswick, MD (WV Public Broadcasting and Third News, Oct 13-14). Preferred and alternate routes are due in early/mid 2027. Campbell County, VA and Loudoun County, VA have passed resolutions opposing it.
why_k2: Mixed fit with K2's plan: the West Virginia part (Amos to Welton Spring) is in a priority market, but the northern end runs toward Northern Virginia, the one market the plan avoids. Kept for awareness.
